title: My garden was wet every morning. It hadn't rained in six weeks.
description:
An old man gave me the key to his allotment plot when his knees gave out. That spring it didn't rain for six weeks, and every plot on the hill cracked in the sun. Except mine. Mine was dark and wet at every dawn.

Then a head came up out of the soil by the gate, and each morning it was one bed further down the path, nearer to my beans.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: How deep do you think that hole in plot one went?
